description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrade procedures for Linksys devices running OpenWrt, including determining the target firmware partition and performing platform-specific upgrade steps.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the current target firmware partition by checking environment variables and UBI partition information, and switches the boot environment for next boot accordingly.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs platform-specific firmware upgrade steps, including identifying target partitions, handling UBI volumes, and executing the upgrade process based on the provided image.
